name: launch-keynote
summary: Product-launch keynote look: near-black and off-white grounds alternating per scene, one short sentence per screen in large Paperlogy, the book treated as a hero product (slow CSS-3D turns, specular light sweep, macro push-ins on the real cover), minimal device mockups, generous negative space. Motion is slow and eased (power2/expo, 0.8–1.6 s), entrances by blur-to-sharp and soft rise, scene changes by dip-to-black / cross-dissolve inside frames. One accent color taken from the cover, used on one word or dot at most.
font_line: Paperlogy 800/500/400 (embedded, Korean) / IBM Plex Mono 500 (numerals in UI only)
verdict: REJECTED by the user on ADsP (2026-10-08): '이 감성은 아니다' — the earlier bold-beat clean cut fits the house better. Keep for explicit requests only.
